note: Sports-day cue cards: the signs held up in the spoon relay and the three-legged race (せえの / みぎ / ひだり = Go! / Right / Left; the rhythm the player follows, so gameplay-relevant). TAIIKU .BIN files are 8-bpp 128x128 pages from file offset 0x2000; the cards are on SPOON.BIN page 6 (0x1A000) at x 80..128, y 64..112: card fill 23, strokes 76 / 77 with a light ring 38, border 46 / 129. The same page is a byte copy in NININ.BIN (0x26000) and TAI_BG.BIN (0x1E000), patched through `copies`. CLUT = the 256 colours at file offset 0. English DRAFT.
